interface.shortDescription: Ask about the places you saved in Pinmo
interface.longDescription: Look up the places you saved in Pinmo by city, tag, date or keyword, and get a day-by-day review of a trip. Read-only: it reads the time, place, tags and note of your saved records, never your photos, voice notes or drafts, and it cannot change anything.
